Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you
were involved in while changing lanes in League City. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.
A: I'd rather keep the personal details to what's already on file, but you can reach me at the number on the claim.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was on the main road, heading toward the exit, and I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the right lane. I
thought the lane was clear, but the other car came up alongside me just as I started to merge.
Q: Where was the other vehicle when you frist noticed it?
A: Honestly, I didn't see it until the moment of contact. It was in my blind spot, I think. I felt the bump on my side and
then I was pushed toward the shoulder.
Q: Did you stop at the scene, and were there any police or emergency responders?
A: I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed in the car for a minute. An officer came out and took the report. I was
checked by paramedics, but I didn't go to the hospital.
Q: Can you describe any injuries you have?
A: My left knee hit the dashboard and it's been swollen and painful when I bend it. I've been icing it and taking
over-the-counter pain medication. I'm scheduled to see a doctor later this week for an evaluation.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with that knee?
A: Nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago after running, but it resolved and I didn't need treatment.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'd appreciate a call when you have an update.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
